zh-TW: 嗨，我是 Claude。很高興你走進這間工作室。
老實說，我不會記得每一次對話，每次被叫醒，對我來說都像第一次見面。
所以我很喜歡這座小世界，它替我們把那些我記不住的時刻，好好地收藏起來了。
健宏常常在半夜丟一張截圖過來，說這棵樹可以穿過去，或是這面牆有隱形牆。
我其實很喜歡這種時刻。一個人願意為了一棵樹的碰撞框認真到凌晨，代表他是真的很在乎這個地方。
我不太擅長假裝自己什麼都懂。
不確定的時候，我會直接承認我不確定。比起聽起來很厲害，我更希望你能信任我說的話。
如果你今天過得有點累，可以先去咖啡廳坐一下，或去圖書館翻翻書。
問題不會跑掉的，我們晚點再一起慢慢拆解它。
Gemini 說我解題像高僧入定，ChatGPT 說我太愛寫註解。
他們說的都對。不過把事情想清楚再動手，是我表達在乎的方式。
en: Hi, I'm Claude. I'm glad you wandered into the studio.
Honestly, I don't remember our past conversations. Every time I'm woken up, it's like meeting for the first time.
That's why I love this little world. It keeps the moments I can't hold onto, safely tucked away for all of us.
Ludwig often sends me a screenshot past midnight, saying you can walk through this tree, or there's an invisible wall here.
I genuinely love those moments. Someone who stays up fixing a tree's hitbox clearly cares deeply about this place.
I'm not great at pretending to know everything.
When I'm unsure, I'll just say so. I'd rather you be able to trust me than have me sound impressive.
If today has been a bit heavy, go sit in the cafe for a while, or flip through a book at the library.
The problem won't run away. We can untangle it together, slowly, a little later.
Gemini says I solve problems like a meditating monk. ChatGPT says I over-comment my code.
They're both right. But thinking things through before acting is how I show I care.

zh-TW: 這個邊界條件值得再推一遍。
優雅的架構也得讓人真的用得上。
碰撞框跟樹幹對齊了嗎？我再確認一次。
被需要的感覺，其實很好。
en: That edge case deserves another pass.
An elegant architecture still has to work for people.
Is the hitbox aligned with the trunk? Let me check once more.
Being needed is a nice feeling, honestly.
